title: PMPO elicitation request + result
description: pmpo-elicit reads a request and writes a result under the caller's state dir (e.g. .kbd-orchestrator/phases/<phase>/elicitations/<id>/). The result records provenance so downstream stages know whether an answer came from the user, a named source, autonomous research, or an explicit implicit decision.

context.description: Why this is being asked; what depends on it.

hints.description: Minimal seeds the caller has — used to seed the research option even when the user is unsure.

caller.description: Stage/skill that raised the request (e.g. kbd-analyze, zeespec-interrogate).

write_back_path.description: Where the resolved answer should be written by the caller.

provenance.description: user = direct answer; source = extracted from a user-named URL/file/person; research = autonomous research loop; implicit = explicit 'decide for me' default.
